$comment: Cron schedules are UTC. IST is UTC+05:30 and India observes no DST.
generate-deliveries runs TWICE against the same target day, deliberately.
30 15 * * *  = 21:00 IST — the main run, fired at the order cutoff itself.
30 20 * * *  = 02:00 IST — a safety net, two hours before the 04:00 cook,
so a missed or failed main run cannot leave a morning with
Two runs are safe because the job is idempotent (it skips deliveries that
already exist) AND because the cutoff now lives in the subscriber predicate
in lib/order-cutoff.ts instead of in this schedule. The second run returns
exactly the same subscriber set and cannot admit an order placed after 21:00.
Changing these times no longer changes who eats — that is the point.
